description: Formlabs Alpha Fast resin, Form Studio 1, post-cured 2 min. Compressed between the flat platens of the Breakerspace Instron 68TM-50: the upper platen on the two prong tops, the bottom face on the lower platen. One specimen loaded to failure: peak 4.80 kN at 2.56 mm, then cracking (saw-tooth load drops) to the break at 8.66 mm. Displacement is the crosshead travel (no extensometer).
notes: The curve is soft up to 0.5 mm / 880 N (about 1.7 kN/mm, roughly 60 % of the later slope) and stiffens sharply there: one prong probably touched the platen first (prong tops not level) or the part was seating. The fit uses the straight part after that kink, 1050-1800 N (about 2.69 kN/mm); above it the resin yields (peak 4.8 kN). The material value in the statement is the datasheet's default post-cure tensile modulus (2230 MPa; flexural 2110 MPa; max-strength post-cure 2540 MPa). An ASTM D638 Type I dogbone of the same resin, also measured by crosshead, starts at about 640 N/mm: an apparent modulus of about 1.6 GPa with nominal Type I dimensions. Crosshead readings include grip seating and machine compliance, so that is a lower bound on the modulus, not a measurement of it. The data were digitized from the plot in the machine's PDF report (about +-0.01 mm, +-15 N).
